name: sprinty
description: Disciplined sprint workflow for Codex CLI: dashboard-at-start, feature subsprints, artifacts, dependency graphs, coverage gates, changelogs, and change maps.

interface.shortDescription: Run dashboard-backed, ledgered development sprints from Codex CLI.
interface.longDescription: Sprinty gives Codex CLI a sprint workflow with server-minted IDs, feature subsprints, item gates, dashboard-at-start guidance, sprint artifacts, dependency graphs with cycle detection, Git-backed change maps, Markdown changelogs, and coverage-required close gates.
defaultPrompt: Use Sprinty to run this implementation as a disciplined sprint.
Start or continue the sprint with explicit git_dir and data_dir, then share the dashboard URL returned by sprint_new or sprint_resume.
Track each feature as a subsprint, create atomic items with item_add, attach durable outputs with artifact_add/list/get/update, and use item_split when work is too large.
Resolve every item with item_done, passing gates, a real commit, and a changelog entry; then close with coverage so Sprinty writes the canonical changelog automatically.
